clips.title: The story
paras: Stonegear's Search is an Alliance directive directing adventurous travelers to Pilot Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. The enthusiastic siege engine operator has caught wind of an exotic mineral and seeks a daring explorer to track down fresh fuel for his tank's ordnance.

Dwarven siege engines are legendary feats of engineering, but their operators are rarely content leaving well enough alone. Word around Ironforge and Loch Modan quickly spreads that Pilot Stonegear, stationed just outside the capital, is scheming to boost his war machine's punch. Whether pointed his way by Pilot Longbeard or Mountaineer Kadrell, travelers are recruited simply to meet the ambitious pilot and hear his proposal.

Pilot Stonegear makes his workshop at Steelgrill's Depot, the proving ground and staging yard tucked along the road just east of Kharanos. Amid clanking gears and spewing steam, Stonegear keeps watch for prospectors brave enough to pursue a volatile, rare ore known to ignite his tank's firepower to devastating new heights.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should! And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!
He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him. If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello friend. You're here about the task I have, eh? It's good to see a young traveler like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!
